name: Sphene Lake Fire Tower
summary: Fire tower at Sphene Lake, Rainy River District; a fan-run still-standing list names a Sphene Lake Tower near Rainy Lake, not confirmed as this tower, and no source confirms its condition or the 1924 date in a video title.

access.note: Remote lake. The former camp land is owned by Rainy River First Nations, and no source says whether the tower stands on it. The fan-run list asks visitors not to climb.

visit.trail_note: Remote: the camp tribute describes the lake as reached by water, air, winter ice and, at times, rough logging roads. No source describes a route to the tower.
